note: Every rule here is invented for the demo. It follows the shape of typical Taiwanese university regulations but belongs to no real school.

rules.title: Course withdrawal
rules.text: After the add/drop period you may withdraw from a course until the end of week 12. Apply in the course system under 停修申請. At most 2 courses per semester. A withdrawn course shows W on the transcript and does not count toward GPA. Withdrawal cannot be undone.

rules.title: Minimum credits
rules.text: Undergraduates must keep at least 9 credits after withdrawal; graduate students at least 1 course. International students on a student residence permit must stay enrolled full time; dropping below the minimum must be reported to the Office of International Affairs (OIA) within 7 days.

rules.title: Half-credit failure rule
rules.text: An undergraduate who fails more than half of the credits taken in each of two semesters is dismissed. Withdrawn courses (W) are not counted as failed credits.

rules.title: Approvals
rules.text: A withdrawal request needs approval from the course instructor and then your academic advisor (導師). The system sends the request automatically; approval usually takes 3 to 5 working days. If the instructor does not respond before the week 12 deadline, contact the department office (系辦).

rules.title: Required courses
rules.text: You may withdraw from a required course (必修), but you must retake it later to graduate. Check with the department office whether it is offered next semester.

rules.title: Fees after withdrawal
rules.text: Tuition and credit fees (學分費) are not refunded for withdrawn courses.

rules.title: Scholarships and withdrawal
rules.text: Some scholarships require a minimum number of completed credits per semester. Withdrawal can make you lose eligibility. International students on the Taiwan Scholarship or a school scholarship should ask OIA before withdrawing.

rules.title: Reason field
rules.text: The reason field is free text and is read by the instructor and advisor. A short honest reason is enough, for example workload or schedule conflict. Medical reasons do not need a certificate for withdrawal.

fieldRules._note: Which rules matter for which field on 停修申請. Written by hand from the rules; the model is told only these.
